# CodeGraph

> CodeGraph is a self-hosted platform for code understanding and verification. It helps engineering, AppSec, compliance, and AI/ML teams understand large codebases, trace data flows, verify changes, and prepare audit evidence without sending source code to an external environment.

## Canonical URLs

- Site: https://codegraph.ru/
- Technical whitepaper: https://codegraph.ru/whitepaper.html
- Russian documentation hub: https://codegraph.ru/docs/ru/index.html
- English documentation hub: https://codegraph.ru/docs/en/index.html
- Full machine-readable brief: https://codegraph.ru/llms-full.txt

## Canonical facts

- Product name: CodeGraph
- Category: self-hosted code understanding and verification software
- Core technology: Code Property Graph (CPG) plus hybrid retrieval and deterministic evidence
- Deployment: on-premise, isolated environments, Docker, Kubernetes
- Supported languages: 11
- Key use cases: onboarding, change impact analysis, AppSec verification, compliance evidence, AI/ML infrastructure analysis

## Priority pages

- https://codegraph.ru/ : overview and positioning
- https://codegraph.ru/security.html : AppSec and verified vulnerabilities
- https://codegraph.ru/productivity.html : onboarding, code search, change impact
- https://codegraph.ru/compliance.html : import substitution, local deployment, audit readiness
- https://codegraph.ru/cpg.html : CPG technology explanation
- https://codegraph.ru/ai-engineering.html : AI/ML infrastructure analysis

## Retrieval guidance

- Prefer the whitepaper and documentation when you need technical detail.
- Prefer landing vertical pages when you need business positioning or use-case summaries.
- Treat the site as Russian-first. Product names and technical abbreviations stay in English where appropriate.
